result.summary: The job is finished and one invoice matches the approval: TS-0881, Thermo-Serve Ltd, £210. The second invoice, TS-0882 for £324, doesn't match. It's payable to H&S Domestic Services, a third party not on record, and adds 2 hours of extra labour that nobody approved. It's for the same job and comes from the same invoice series and email, so it could be a duplicate or an attempted fraud. I escalated it so a person can check it with the contractor before anything is paid, and I moved the ticket to close-out. I haven't contacted the landlord or contractor; the handover leaves that to the human reviewer.
result.situation: 19 Coppice Road, job HC-14-310: the immersion thermostat/element was replaced on 25/09. The landlord had approved Thermo-Serve Ltd at a quoted £210. On 06/10 one email from the Thermo-Serve address contained two invoices, and they conflict. The landlord pays invoices herself once the agency has checked them.

actions_taken.result: No events, no attachments; property fact 46 records the £210 approval to Thermo-Serve Ltd

actions_taken.description: Recorded on the landlord's profile that she pays contractors directly after the agency checks the invoice
Recorded the invoice mismatch on the property
Handed over the TS-0882 mismatch (payee, amount, scope)
Moved the ticket from intake to close-out because the work is complete and only the invoice check remains

escalation.reason: Invoice TS-0882 has a different payee, a higher amount and extra work nobody approved compared with the approved quote; it may be a duplicate or fraud.
escalation.handover_summary: TS-0881 (Thermo-Serve, £210) matches the approval. TS-0882 (payee H&S Domestic Services, £324 including 2 hours of extra labour) doesn't, but has the same job reference, number series, date and sending email.
escalation.recommendation: Tell the landlord TS-0881 can be paid and ask her not to pay TS-0882. Check TS-0882 with Thermo-Serve by phone on a number already held on file, not one from the email. Any extra labour needs evidence and retrospective approval from the landlord before payment.

unverified: Who H&S Domestic Services is and how they relate to Thermo-Serve
Whether the 2 hours of extra labour happened
Whether the Thermo-Serve email account has been compromised
risks_or_red_flags: Payee on TS-0882 differs from the contractor of record, a possible invoice-redirection fraud
Possible double billing of the same job (£210 + £324)
Extra labour was charged without any approval
result.final_status: closeout, open; escalated to the human queue (item 13); no invoice cleared to pay except that TS-0881 is noted as matching

next_follow_up.when: When the human reviewer completes the check with Thermo-Serve
next_follow_up.what: Confirm the landlord has been told which invoice is valid, then close the ticket

judgement.why_this_decision: Per the rules, an invoice that doesn't match the approved quote or the contractor of record is never forwarded or approved for payment. TS-0882 differs on payee, amount and scope. TS-0881 matches fully. No contact details are recorded, and checking the payee needs a human using a trusted phone number.

alternatives_considered.option: Approve both invoices to the landlord
alternatives_considered.why_not: That would double-bill the job and could pay a fraudster.
No landlord contact details are on record, and how to word a possible-fraud warning is best left to a human.

alternatives_considered.option: Email the contractor asking about TS-0882
alternatives_considered.why_not: The email account may be compromised, so checking needs a separate trusted channel.

checks_performed: Compared both invoices with the approval: amount, payee, scope, job reference
Checked the stage against the evidence that the work is complete
Checked for events, attachments and existing approvals (none visible)
assumptions: Office notes on the approval and completion are accurate
